dedupe_keys.name: typical and heatwave future weather files epw for turin bolzano and de bilt

description: This dataset provides future weather files in EnergyPlus EPW format for building energy simulation in Turin and Bolzano, Italy, and De Bilt, Netherlands, as typical meteorological years and heatwave scenarios. It was published on Zenodo on 11 August 2025 by Milad Heiranipour and Fabio Favoino of Politecnico di Torino and Miren Juaristi Gutierrez and Stefano Avesani of Eurac Research. Files come from three methods: morphing with CCWeatherGen 1.9, statistical generation with Meteonorm 8.2.0, and dynamical downscaling from regional climate models under RCP8.5 following the IEA EBC Annex 80 method; years are 2020, 2050 and 2080, and heatwave files mark the longest, most intense or most severe events. Coverage: three cities, hourly data. Access: EPW files and a heatwave information sheet on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: only the high-emission RCP8.5 pathway for the climate-model files. Simulation uses: overheating and cooling-demand assessment of buildings under present and future heatwaves. Related records: the ORNL future typical meteorological years and CAHDC climate-adjusted HVAC design conditions.
